en.p: For two integers $\alpha$, $\beta\ (\alpha>\beta)$, there is a sequence $\{a_n\}$ satisfying the following condition.

box: For every natural number $n$, $a_n=\alpha\times\sin\dfrac{n}{2}\pi+\beta\times\cos\dfrac{n}{2}\pi$, and $a_1\times a_2\times a_3\times a_4=4$.

en.p: For the sequence $\{a_n\}$ and a geometric sequence $\{b_n\}$ with $b_1>0$, when
$b_1\times b_3=\dfrac{q}{p}$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
